newsitem.title: USA: Cervecerias Unidas files for ADR offer.
newsitem.headline: Cervecerias Unidas files for ADR offer.

text.p: Compania Cervecerias Unidas SA said it is has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the public offering of 3.135 million american depository shares.
Each ADR represents five shares of common stock, and the offering will represent 15.675 million common shares, the company said.
The Chilean beer maker said it will also offer 1,197,608 common shares via an offering in Chile.
On closing of the combined offering, the company will begin a 30-day pre-emptive rights offering covering an additional 37,901,286 common shares, it said.

The company said its principal shareholder, a venture 50 percent owned by the Luksie Group of Chile and the Schorghuber Group of Germany, has advised that it will buy 18,865,142 common shares in the pre-emptive offering at the price which shares are sold in the combined offering.
